model_policy: Record the exact model and family for every response. Replicas from one model are not independent model evidence. Scorer family must differ from respondent family.

mid_plus.lexical: common and academic with contextual guessing
mid_plus.inference: one step plus limited two step

high.inference: two step and alternative evaluation with cited evidence

middle_1.lexical_access: common words available; academic and rare words limited
middle_1.syntax_capacity: simple and coordinated clauses available; embedded clauses limited
middle_1.discourse_capacity: explicit cause available; implicit contrast and paragraph function limited
middle_1.inference_capacity: one-step inference available; two-step inference limited

high_1.lexical_access: common and some academic words available; rare words limited
high_1.syntax_capacity: coordinated and subordinate clauses available; deep embedding limited
high_1.discourse_capacity: explicit relations and some paragraph functions available
high_1.inference_capacity: one-step and some two-step inference available

analysis_policy: Report synthetic item facility and corrected item-total association descriptively. No human-equivalent N, IRT parameter, grade pass band, educational validation, Gold-S, or DB seed before external benchmark calibration.
